changes.text: Every Mt. San Antonio program the harvest read is loaded for your reading: 313 records, unchecked, beside the four checked in the pilot.
The records' course titles, C-ID, CCN and M-ID numbers and CPL counts reached all 292 Cerritos and pilot records, after your go.
The harvest reads programs COCI lists as Approved too, after your go; Cerritos and Mt. San Antonio are being read for them now.
Every Mt. San Antonio program was matched to its own catalog page and drafted; 291 of 317 pass the three machine checks.
Each course on a record shows its title, its C-ID, CCN and M-ID numbers with their titles, and its CPL count, which opens the exhibits behind it.
An answered call carries a check, and opening a call's record starts side by side; where a catalog will not show inside the tab, the record opens in a window on the right half beside it.
Your to-dos sit under the tab's title, every record has Side by side, and Show the blocks works.
The call card answers its records: open each to its catalog page and choose Confirm or Needs a fix right there.
Program records can be searched by name or control number and narrowed to the records waiting on your reading; each Cerritos card says how many listed courses it placed.
Every Cerritos program the harvest read is loaded for your reading: 270 records, unchecked, beside the four checked in the pilot.
Every Cerritos program was matched to its own catalog page and drafted; 235 of 283 pass the three machine checks.
The funding explainer's typed passages can be edited on the tab, and its header was cleaned to your marks.
The Library tab's open-asks record points at Sheet 57, after your paste.
The Dashboard tab passed its first accessibility pass in light and dark: its calculation notes, College Activity colors, focus rings and small buttons.
The Fact Sheet moved to First Light's type with a dark mode, after you said it looks great.
On the Fact Sheet, Ask Sierra and the Send button read clearly when you point at them.
SkyView's chip colors follow the house palette by day and at night, and three of its controls read clearly at night.
The accessibility pass now reaches a screen nobody has checked before it checks one again.
The funding explainer's Columns menu opens on the screen at every width, here and on this tab.
The privacy page uses the house fonts and follows the dark setting.
The Library's record of the decision sheets points at Sheet 56.
The Fact Sheet's links and buttons reach the 24px size, its toolbar uses words, and on a phone the toolbar scrolls away.
